commit.message:
Refresh leaderboard.json from Kaggle every 15 minutes with GitHub Actions

The workflow runs the aggregator (a generated, dependency-free copy of
v2d_challenge_leaderboard/aggregate/v2d_aggregate.py plus a trimmed
tracks.json) and commits leaderboard.json only when the standings change.
It needs one repository secret, KAGGLE_API_TOKEN.

Drops publish.sh, which targeted an org repo that was never created.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Publish an empty payload, not sample data

Every track, metric, unit, direction and competition slug is read from the
config, so the page renders its real tabs and columns and says 'no entries yet'
under each. Fabricated teams would have put numbers nobody earned on an NVIDIA
page, and would have been indistinguishable from real standings to anyone who
did not know.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Leaderboard data for the V2D Challenge page

Machine-written by aggregate/v2d_aggregate.py. Separate from the site repo so a
scheduled refresh never collides with a human editing the challenge page.

Includes .nojekyll: GitHub Pages runs Jekyll by default, which would not serve
a bare JSON from the repo root reliably.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
